titleFormatted.en: Set the energy price to [[price]] per kWh [[currency]]

hint.en: Changes the price per kWh used for the cost of finished cycles (the same price as Settings, Monitors, Energy cost). Use it from your own Flows for a tariff that changes: at 18:00 set the peak price, at 21:00 the off-peak one, or follow the trigger of an energy-price app. A cycle is priced at the price in force when it finishes. A price of 0 turns the cost off. Leave the currency empty to keep the current one.
